verdicts.reason: A is just the original shrunk and centred, with large blank white bars down both sides. Nothing was rearranged for the wide format, the orange header and photo end abruptly at the bars, and the photo is cropped at the bottom. Even so, it is balanced and intact. B makes the same shrink-without-redesign mistake but pins the design to the left, leaving about a third of the canvas on the right empty, so the layout is badly lopsided and plainly unfinished.
